title: Practice 7: Two verbs for every way of going

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: И к нам ___ (ездить — to go by vehicle, ride, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 3rd pl.).
exercises.why: **ездят** — present tense (3rd person plural) of ездить: many-directions verb (one direction: ехать).

exercises.q: ___ (ездить — to go by vehicle, ride, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 1st sg.), как же.
exercises.why: **езжу** — present tense (1st person singular) of ездить: many-directions verb (one direction: ехать).

exercises.q: Он ___ (ездить — to go by vehicle, ride, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 3rd sg.) к ним?
exercises.why: **ездит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of ездить: many-directions verb (one direction: ехать).

exercises.q: Ну, что, ___ (ездить — to go by vehicle, ride, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 2nd sg.)?.
exercises.why: **ездишь** — present tense (2nd person singular) of ездить: many-directions verb (one direction: ехать).

exercises.q: А в театр ___ (ездить — to go by vehicle, ride, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 2nd sg.)?
exercises.why: **ездишь** — present tense (2nd person singular) of ездить: many-directions verb (one direction: ехать).

exercises.q: А в гости ___ (ездить — to go by vehicle, ride, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 2nd pl.)?
exercises.why: **ездите** — present tense (2nd person plural) of ездить: many-directions verb (one direction: ехать).

exercises.q: Хорошо ___ (ездить — to go by vehicle, ride, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 3rd sg.), а?
exercises.why: **ездит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of ездить: many-directions verb (one direction: ехать).

exercises.q: Это, может, вы ___ (летать — to fly, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 2nd pl.), а не Айшер!
exercises.why: **летаете** — present tense (2nd person plural) of летать: many-directions verb (one direction: лететь).

exercises.q: Вы ___ (ездить — to go by vehicle, ride, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 2nd pl.) в театор?
exercises.why: **ездите** — present tense (2nd person plural) of ездить: many-directions verb (one direction: ехать).

exercises.q: Я пять дней не ___ (ездить — to go by vehicle, ride, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 1st sg.)!
exercises.why: **езжу** — present tense (1st person singular) of ездить: many-directions verb (one direction: ехать).

exercises.q: Как же ты чувствуешь себя, когда ___ (летать — to fly, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 2nd sg.)?.
exercises.why: **летаешь** — present tense (2nd person singular) of летать: many-directions verb (one direction: лететь).

exercises.q: Сейчас ты не ___ (летать — to fly, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 2nd sg.), но я ведь знаю секрет твоих успехов.
exercises.why: **летаешь** — present tense (2nd person singular) of летать: many-directions verb (one direction: лететь).

exercises.q: Кто ж их знать может: дела сами не ___ (ходить — to go, walk, there and back or in general; impf., pres. 3rd pl.), водить их надо.
exercises.why: **ходют** — present tense (3rd person plural) of ходить: many-directions verb (one direction: идти).
